chapter: Vernon Andrade's band and Harlem life
title: Andrade's band outplays Cab Calloway at the Savoy
summary: Andrade's band was booked at the Savoy; one night they were so good Cab's band could not get back on the stand.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: Yeah, we played the theaters, and we had entertainment in the Saville. Louie would sing, and George Washington would sing, and we had the group would sing. And we stayed with -- stationed there on the -- and then we went up to the Savoy too.
We caught Cab up there once. We (unintelligible) him up.
We caught Cab Calloway's band came in there one night, couldn't get back on the bandstand.
Oh, that was before Cab got his band together.
He had his band together, but had his good band then, but he -- we just was too much for him. So the manager of the Savoy, he got on top Andrade -- he

you're killing come and said, hey, (unintelligible) my attraction. Andrade was a quiet fellow. He was a Panamanian. He said— he looked at me, he said, what about it, Hap? I said, we're attraction too.
